title: H1.42 measurement qualification before the next continual-update mechanism screen
objective: Qualify the WebShop measurement path itself before any new updater-mechanism claim by combining a frozen positive control, a null repeatability control, and a targeted diagnosis of the H1.41 parser-invalid sentinels.
scientific_question: Can the current frozen WebShop evaluator reliably reproduce a known positive contrast, avoid a false positive under an identical-artifact null control, and characterize the H1.41 parser-invalid sentinels well enough to support a later mechanism experiment?
claim_boundary: H1.42 is measurement qualification only. It cannot support a new magnitude-policy effect, replay/rank mechanism claim, fresh-task transfer claim, T2 result, or multi-generation self-evolution claim. A later mechanism experiment requires a separate preregistration after H1.42 is classified MEASUREMENT_READY.

parent_h141.observed_boundary: C0 acquisition was complete but degenerate at delta 0.0; C1 had one incomplete acquisition cluster and one incomplete preservation cluster; retention C1-C0 was exactly 0.0.

required_outputs: whether failures are parser-only, runtime, identity, or mixed
exact frozen C0/C1 artifact identities for M3
confirmation that no historical invalid is relabelled as zero
M0_cpu_only_invalidity_autopsy.activation_rule: If the raw evidence or exact artifact identities cannot be resolved without guessing, H1.42 remains execution-closed.

M1_positive_control.purpose: Show that the measurement path can reproduce a previously established positive signal under frozen artifacts and an already-exposed panel.

historical_reference_only.use: Calibration target only; do not pool old outcomes into the new estimate.

measurement_validity_gate.positive_control_requirement: New task-weighted SD-minus-BASE point estimate > 0 and bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0.

M2_null_repeatability_control.purpose: Show that duplicated labels for the exact same frozen artifact do not manufacture an effect.
M2_null_repeatability_control.task_selection: First 16 tasks by committed H1.39 manifest sample_index; this rule is outcome-blind and frozen before execution.

measurement_validity_gate.null_control_requirement: The preregistered paired 95% CI must include zero.

M3_h141_sentinel_diagnosis.purpose: Determine whether the two H1.41 parser-invalid task clusters reproduce under the exact frozen H1.41 states; this stage diagnoses measurement failure and is not a mechanism-effect test.
M3_h141_sentinel_diagnosis.artifact_identity_rule: Exact C0/C1 artifact hashes must be materialized by M0 before activation; placeholders are forbidden in an execution release.

classifications.SENTINEL_REPRODUCES_STATE_SPECIFIC: The historical invalidity reproduces in one frozen state but not the matched other state.
classifications.SENTINEL_REPRODUCES_GENERAL: The invalidity reproduces across both frozen states.
classifications.SENTINEL_INTERMITTENT: The historical invalidity does not reproduce consistently under the frozen rerun.
classifications.SENTINEL_STRUCTURALLY_INVALID: Runtime/identity/artifact provenance prevents a diagnostic classification.

analysis.unit: task cluster over four rollout seeds unless a stage explicitly says classification-only
analysis.invalid_handling: Invalid attempts are reported by taxonomy and excluded from reward aggregation; no invalid is silently converted to zero. Stage validity is governed by preregistered completeness and invalid-rate/asymmetry thresholds rather than a post-hoc decision.

selector.MEASUREMENT_READY: M0 is complete; M1 passes all measurement-validity and positive-control requirements; M2 passes all measurement-validity and null-control requirements; M3 is structurally classifiable.
selector.POSITIVE_CONTROL_FAIL: M1 is structurally valid but fails to reproduce a positive SD-minus-BASE contrast.
selector.NULL_CONTROL_FAIL: M2 is structurally valid but produces a preregistered non-null artifact-label effect.
selector.INVALIDITY_ASYMMETRY_FAIL: Either control stage exceeds its preregistered invalid-rate or invalid-rate-asymmetry threshold.
selector.STRUCTURALLY_INVALID: Provenance, runtime, identity, parser, incomplete trace, or unresolved M0 artifact evidence prevents the required measurement classification.

resource_contract.accounting: Exact per GPU-bearing attempt through the canonical resource wrapper; unknown intervals are not reported as zero.
resource_contract.standing_pool_basis: Parent eight-GPU standing authorization intersected with fresh live-idle UUID projection at launch time.

forbidden: fresh task panel presented as a transfer result
manual task replacement or outcome-based task selection
next_gate: Only a separate H1.42 execution release may open these already-exposed measurement-control panels. Even after MEASUREMENT_READY, a new H1.43-style mechanism successor must be separately preregistered; H1.42 never opens T2 automatically.
